title: Enhance product management with easier stock editing and total inventory value display

requirements.summary: Add quick stock adjustment controls (+/-) to ProductManagementTable for immediate inventory updates
acceptanceCriteria: Increment (+) and decrement (-) buttons appear next to each product's inventory count in the table
Clicking increment increases stock by 1 and immediately saves via backend
Clicking decrement decreases stock by 1 (minimum 0) and immediately saves via backend
Stock changes update the product without requiring full row edit mode
Loading state shown during stock update operations
Toast notification displays success or error after stock change

file_operations.description: Add increment and decrement button controls next to the inventory count field in each product row. Create inline handlers that call the updateInventoryCount backend method with productId and new inventory value (current ± 1, with minimum 0). Display loading state during the mutation and show toast notifications on success or error. Ensure buttons are disabled during loading and that the table refetches product data after successful updates.

Add useUpdateInventoryCount mutation hook that calls actor.updateInventoryCount(productId, newCount). Configure the mutation to invalidate the products query on success to trigger automatic refetch of the product list. Return loading, error, and mutate states for UI consumption.

requirements.summary: Display total inventory value on Dashboard showing sum of (price × inventory) for all products
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays a new statistics card showing 'Total Inventory Value' alongside existing metrics
Value is calculated as the sum of (product price × inventory count) for all products
Display formats the value as currency (e.g., '$1,234.56')
Value updates automatically when products are added, edited, or deleted
Calculation includes all products regardless of their availability status

file_operations.description: Add a new statistics card to the dashboard grid that displays 'Total Inventory Value'. Use the useTotalInventoryValue hook to fetch the total value from the backend. Format the value as currency using a formatter (e.g., new Intl.NumberFormat with currency style). Display loading state while fetching and handle errors gracefully. Position the card alongside existing product count and revenue metrics in the statistics section.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hook useTotalInventoryValue for fetching total inventory value with automatic refetching
acceptanceCriteria: Hook fetches total inventory value from backend getTotalInventoryValue() method
Hook requires admin authentication via useActor
Query invalidates and refetches when products query invalidates
Returns loading, error, and data states for UI consumption
Integrates with existing React Query setup in the project

file_operations.description: Add useTotalInventoryValue query hook that fetches the total inventory value by calling actor.getTotalInventoryValue(). Use queryKey ['totalInventoryValue'] and enable the query only when actor is available. Configure the hook to automatically refetch when the products query is invalidated by including appropriate query key dependencies. Return loading, error, and data (bigint) states for consumption by the Dashboard component.
